children: Oil declines in early Asian trade on hopes that Russian diesel can ease global fuel shortages. President Trump said Friday that his administration reached an agreement for Russia to supply hundreds of thousands of tons of diesel fuel. "This would mark a partial lifting of Russia's ban on diesel exports," CBA's Vivek Dhar says in a research report. "If these exports do eventuate, it will provide some relief to a market that is facing diesel shortages, but much will likely depend on Ukraine's ongoing attacks on Russian oil infrastructure," the analyst adds. Front-month WTI crude oil futures and front-month Brent crude oil futures are each 0.9% lower at $91.03 a barrel and $103.82 a barrel, respectively.(ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
